rounds.text: Lexora Global Ltd trades at a staggering price-to-book ratio of 20.10x against a book value of ₹ 9.75 per share [E1], which vastly exceeds the sector benchmark P/B of 7.68x [E6]. This extreme valuation is completely divorced from the company's underlying earning power, highlighted by an astronomical P/E ratio of 1400x compared to a sector benchmark of just 52.12x [E5]. Compounded profit growth tells a deeply concerning story of contraction, dropping by 15% over three years [E13] and declining by 4% over the trailing twelve months [E14]. Furthermore, the return on equity sits at an anemic 1.38%, trailing the already modest sector benchmark of 2% [E8], while the business offers shareholders a dividend yield of zero [E3]. Conceded: the company demonstrates a positive ROA of 1.87% that compares favorably to a deeply negative sector benchmark of -349.63% [E7], and has achieved a 120% compounded share price growth over three years [E15].
